integrity: The infinite result follows from an exact reduction of both total Roman conditions to partwise adjacency statements. The polynomial is obtained by a disjoint partition according to the number of parts containing label 2, and an independent brute-force verifier checks the literal definition against the formula on all complete multipartite profiles through order 9.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns ordinary total Roman domination on connected complete multipartite graphs only.
The scalar minimum formula is a corollary; originality is claimed for the all-function characterization and exact weight enumerator.

The full text of the 2013 Liu--Chang source was not available in the inspected public sources; its abstract was inspected, leaving a residual bibliographic risk for hidden special cases or alternate terminology.
Finite exhaustive verification through order 9 is supplementary evidence and is not used as a proof of the infinite theorem.

The day-level public anchor is the author-uploaded accepted manuscript dated 2016-08-11; the earlier 2013 general source was identified bibliographically, but no exact public posting day for it was verified.
title: Exact weight enumerator of total Roman dominating functions on complete multipartite graphs
